info.name: Velora CRM API
info.description: API collection for Velora Interior Design CRM Backend system. Includes lead lifecycle status management, dashboard analytics, and pending web submission promotion.

request.description: Fetches aggregated stats for the dashboard showing total leads count, active count, completed count, and grouped counts by status and project category.
Fetches unconverted Consultation and Contact form requests from the website, ready to be promoted into CRM leads.

query.description: Filter by status: Inquiry, Consultation, Proposal, Booked, Designing, Production, Installation, Completed, Cancelled
Filter by project category: Modular Kitchen, Wardrobes, Living Room, Bedroom, Bathroom, Dining Room, Commercial Office, Full Home Interior, Other
Search in clientName, clientPhone, clientEmail, or propertyAddress

request.description: Fetches leads list with optional filters for status, category, and text search.

variable.description: The unique MongoDB Object ID of the CRM Lead

request.description: Retrieves the complete profile data of a single CRM Lead, including its full status change history timeline logs.
